issues: get_started.md's install requires 'CUDA>=10.2 with cudnn>=7' and PyTorch built with CUDA (get_started.md:30-36), and the evaluation command launches main.py through torch.distributed.

CUDA-only code path: main.py:315-316 calls torch.cuda.set_device and init_process_group(backend='nccl'), main.py:103 calls model.cuda(), and main.py:246-247 calls .cuda() on every batch. It cannot run on CPU without editing repo source; the recorded pass needed 43 changed lines in main.py and utils.py (repo_diff). By the exam-time rule this repo should have been excluded.

If it stays tested, the goal leaks the diagnosis ('the code assumes CUDA/NCCL so it needs CPU adaptation'), the same leak flagged for microsoft-unilm in the maintained round. The oracle string 'Accuracy of the network on the 16 test images' matches main.py:140-165.
